title: Anxiety
hpi: {{patient_name}} presents with excessive, uncontrollable worry about multiple domains (work, health, finances) occurring most days for ≥6 months, associated with restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, muscle tension, and sleep disturbance. GAD is a chronic anxiety disorder. Must distinguish from: panic disorder (acute episodes), social anxiety (performance situations), PTSD (trauma exposure), substance-induced, medical (hyperthyroidism, pheo, cardiac). Screening: GAD-7. Labs: TSH, tox screen. Treatment: psychotherapy — CBT first-line. Pharmacotherapy: SSRIs first-line (sertraline, escitalopram, paroxetine) or SNRIs (venlafaxine, duloxetine). Response takes 4-6 weeks. Avoid benzodiazepines long-term (dependence, withdrawal, cognitive impairment). Buspirone is an alternative.
